units.source_text: 大師們主觀地將平淡無奇的東西創造得美麗無比，

en.t: The masters subjectively created breathtaking beauty out of things that were utterly ordinary,

units.source_text: 或曰即便他們對醜陋的事物感到噁心嘔吐，也並不掩飾他們的興趣，依舊沉浸在表現的愉悅之中。

en.t: or else, even when ugly things made them feel sick enough to vomit, they did not hide their interest in them, but remained absorbed in the joy of expression.

units.source_text: 換言之，他們絲毫不為別人的觀點所左右。

en.t: In other words, they were not swayed in the slightest by other people's opinions.

units.source_text: 打從竹一那兒獲得原始畫法的祕訣，

en.t: After I received from Takeichi the secret of a primitive method of painting,

units.source_text: 我便瞞著那些女性來客，開始一點一點地著手畫起了自畫像。

en.t: I hid it from those female visitors and began, little by little, to set about painting self-portraits.

units.source_text: 連我自己都頗為震驚的一幅陰鬱的自畫像誕生了。

en.t: A gloomy self-portrait was born, one that startled even me.

units.source_text: 這正是我隱藏於內心深處的真實面目。

en.t: This was precisely the true face I kept hidden deep within my heart.
